lines.text: You got us free tickets? That's awesome!

data.define: Used to say that something is excellent or very enjoyable.

example.text: You got us free tickets? That's awesome!

data.l1_hook: Bạn lấy được vé free cho tụi mình hả?
data.l1_ex: Bạn lấy vé free cho tụi mình hả? Awesome luôn!

native.caption:
“awesome” nghĩa là gì?
“awesome” = Tuyệt vời, đỉnh.
Ví dụ: “You got us free tickets? That's awesome!” (Bạn lấy vé free cho tụi mình hả? Awesome luôn!)
